title: Alliance White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the Icon Alliance White is tuned for city streets, daily work runs, and weekend joyrides. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1315g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~88 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Long Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Icon Alliance full face with aggressive styling.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval to intermediate head shapes; may feel tight on very round heads.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Icon Alliance White: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Icon Alliance White: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide

introduction: Positioned in Icon's Full Face lineup, the Alliance White brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for a Long Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Icon Alliance White represents Icon's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to a Long Oval head shape, the Icon Alliance White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
